answer:
Configure a 2D transient incompressible laminar flow-past-cylinder simulation using pimpleFoam in OpenFOAM.

Physics: Incompressible, laminar, Newtonian flow past a circular cylinder. Kinematic viscosity nu = 1.0e-3 m^2/s. Cylinder diameter D = 1.0 m, centered at origin (0, 0, 0). Inlet velocity U_inlet = 0.1 m/s in direction (1, 0, 0), giving Re = 100, Strouhal number St ~ 0.165, vortex shedding period T_shed ~ 60 s. No turbulence model; turbulenceProperties set to laminar.

Domain: Streamwise extent from x = -20 m to x = +35 m. Transverse extent from y = -20 m to y = +20 m. One cell thick in z. Cylinder at origin with radius R = 0.5 m.

Mesh (blockMeshDict): O-block topology around cylinder transitioning to rectangular far-field blocks. 64 cells around the cylinder circumference. Geometric radial grading in O-block: first-layer thickness ~0.001-0.002 m (targeting y+ ~0.5-1), expansion ratio 1.15-1.2 per layer, approximately 65-70 radial layers from wall to O-block outer boundary (~1-1.5 m radius). Far-field rectangular blocks: ~100 cells in x-direction (streamwise), ~60 cells per side in y-direction (transverse), exactly 1 cell in z-direction. Grading in far-field blocks: cell size matches O-block outer boundary (~0.1-0.15 m) and expands at ratio 1.1-1.15 per layer toward 0.5-1.0 m at far-field boundaries. Symmetric y-grading about y = 0.

Boundary definitions (constant/polyMesh/boundary): Four patches: "inlet" (patch), "outlet" (patch), "cylinderWall" (wall), "frontAndBack" (type empty).

Velocity BCs (0/U): inlet type fixedValue, value uniform (0.1 0 0). outlet type zeroGradient. cylinderWall type noSlip. frontAndBack type empty.

Pressure BCs (0/p): inlet type zeroGradient. outlet type inletOutlet, inletValue uniform 0. cylinderWall type zeroGradient. frontAndBack type empty. Initial p field uniform 0.

Time control (system/controlDict): startTime 0. endTime 800 s (~13 full shedding periods). deltaT 0.1 s (CFL ~0.2). writeInterval 100 s. adjustTimeStep off. startFrom startTime. outputControl timeOutput. writeFormat ascii. functions section for forceCoefficients on cylinderWall patch with CofR (0, 0, 0).

fvSolution: SIMPLE sub-dict with nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 1. PIMPLE sub-dict with nOuterCorrectors 1, nCorrectors 2, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 1, pRefCell 0, pRefValue 0. U solver: smoothSolver symGaussSeidel, tolerance 1e-8, relTol 0. p solver: GAMG or PCG with DIC smoother, tolerance 1e-6, relTol 0. pcorr: PCG, tolerance 1e-5, relTol 0. No relaxation factors (steady under-relaxation not needed for single-outer PIMPLE with nCorrectors 2). residualControl: p 1e-5, U 1e-7.

fvSchemes divSchemes: div(phi,U) bounded Gauss linearUpwind grad(U). div(nuSysDev(U)) bounded Gauss linear. Keep dummy entries for div(phi,k) and div(phi,omega) as bounded Gauss upwind (inactive in laminar, present to avoid parser warnings). div((nuEff*dev2(T(grad(U))))) Gauss linear.

fvSchemes ddtSchemes: default backward (second-order implicit, BDF2).

fvSchemes gradSchemes: default Gauss linear. snGradSchemes: default corrected. laplacianSchemes: default Gauss linear corrected. interpolationSchemes: default linear.

transportProperties: simulationType laminar. nu uniform 1e-3. rho not needed (incompressible solver uses kinematic form).

Execution: pimpleFoam solver. Standard OpenFOAM case structure (0/, constant/, system/). Verify St ~ 0.165 +/- 0.005 from lift coefficient FFT after discarding first 250 s transient. Verify von Karman street visible in vorticity contour plots through 8-10 vortex pairs within 35D downstream.
